articles.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Selenskyj meldet erfolgreiche Reparatur der Druschba-Pipeline
articles.teaser: Die Druschba-Pipeline ist nach Angaben ​des ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj repariert. Die russischen Öllieferungen könnten wieder aufgenommen werden.
articles.image_title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: BRATISLAVA, SLOVAKIA - APRIL 1: General views of the Slovnaft refinery on April 1, 2026 in Bratislava, Slovakia. The images relate to the ongoing fuel crisis, on which Robert Fico Slovak Prime Minister also shared his views earlier today. The Prime Minister's visit to the refinery comes as Slovakia faces a spiralling energy crisis following the shutdown of the Druzhba oil pipeline, which provides Russian crude oil to Slovakia and Hungary via Ukraine, and is processed at the Slovnaft refinery. Flow through the pipeline has been halted since January 27, when Ukraine says a Russian drone strike damaged infrastructure. The fuel crisis in Slovakia is compounded by a global surge in energy prices brought on by the conflict in the Middle East. (Photo by Robert Nemeti/Getty Images)

articles.image_title: Prozess in Istanbul: Die Hinterbliebenen der in Istanbul verstorbenen Familie aus Hamburg, Mutter Cemile Yilmaz und Bruder Mustafa Böcek (l) kommen mit Anwalt Yasar Balci zum Prozess um den Tod einer vierköpfigen Familie. Yilmaz' Sohn hatte für seine Frau und die beiden Kinder einen Urlaub in der türkischen Metropole organisiert. Alle vier starben an einer Vergiftung durch ein im Hotel verwendetes Insektizid. +++ dpa-Bildfunk +++

Libya, located about 300 km from the Italian coast, is one of the main departure points in North Africa for migrants, mostly from sub-Saharan Africa, risking their lives attempting to cross the Mediterranean sea.
